text:
jane_support: FYI opened ticket #12345 from Acme on behalf of their infra team — promo code DEDICATE-TRIAL-2026 applied as hosted credits instead of Dedicated reserved SKU. They bought dedicated-8xA100-month but promo landed on hosted_credit_1000. Customer is on day 2 of trial and wants promo applied to Dedicated. Urgent, please advise.

michael_billing: Can you paste the ledger lines / invoice IDs? I pulled a quick view and I see the promo posted as hosted_credit_1000 on acct 9876.

jane_support: Sure — ledger snippet from billing service:```
{
  "promo_code": "DEDICATE-TRIAL-2026",
  "applied_to": "hosted_credits",
  "applied_amount": "1000.00",
  "invoice_id": "INV-7890",
  "sku": "hosted.api",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-15T14:02:11Z"
}```Customer says they attempted to provision Dedicated but hit quota error. They then used hosted API to smoke-test and the promo auto-applied.

sofia_finance: Quick policy note: promos are SKU-scoped at issuance. If the code was issued for Dedicated but got consumed on hosted usage, we normally issue an equivalent replacement promo or refund the hosted credit and re-issue a dedicated-scoped promo. Need to confirm consumption amount.

ben_eng: Is there an internal tool to reassign a promo application? I can run a one-off migration script against billing ledger, but we need finance approval and audit trail. Prefer to void + reissue to keep accounting clean.

michael_billing: Agreed — prefer void + reissue. @sofia_finance if you approve, I'll queue reversal and generate a new dedicated promo token. If hosted credits already used down to $0, system may return money to account balance only.

jane_support: Customer confirms hosted usage was tiny — single smoke test (approx $3.40). They paused after realizing. They want full promo value applied to their reserved SKU so it counts toward dedicated commitment.

sofia_finance: Approving reissue for equivalent value. I'll create a Dedicated-scoped promo: DEDICATE-REISSUE-17685 and authorize reversal of hosted application. @billing-bot please schedule reversal job and attach audit ticket.

billing-bot: Reversal job queued. job_id=20260315-44. ETA ~2h. Note: reversal path: if hosted credit consumed <= $50 it will be voided and replaced by account balance; we'll then apply new promo to dedicated SKU. Audit ref: AR-2026-0315-44.

ben_eng: I'll hold off on any programmatic transfers until reversal completes. Also adding a small fix note: promo-matcher currently checks account entitlement but not explicit SKU on invoice line; will open ENG ticket to tighten matching rules.

liz_devex: I'll update the public docs FAQ and add a short snippet explaining promo behavior and the workaround (void+reissue). Will drop PR after reversal confirmation. :thumbsup:

jane_support: Thanks — setting ticket status to waiting_on_billing. I'll update customer (ETA ~3h) and ask them to not create additional hosted usage. Will post final resolution here once reversal and reissue done. :eyes:
